Container.Name: omarchy-docker
Container.Overview: Headless Omarchy/Hyprland desktop streamed through Sunshine and Moonlight. This Unraid template uses an Unraid custom LAN network (br0 by default) and an explicit non-privileged device/capability set for the virtual desktop, GPU rendering, Sunshine input, systemd, and Flatpak support. Assign a dedicated IP so Sunshine and future services do not conflict with the host. No host seat rule or input bridge is required.
Container.Requires: NVIDIA Container Toolkit and host devices /dev/dri, /dev/uinput, /dev/tty0, /dev/tty1, and /dev/fuse. This template pulls the published headless image from ghcr.io/remominor/omarchy-docker:headless and runs without privileged mode. Use an Unraid custom LAN network with a dedicated IP so Sunshine retains its standard ports without conflicting with host services. No Omarchy-specific host udev rule or host service is required.

Config.Name: Omarchy home
Config.Description: Persistent Omarchy user home.

Config.Name: Sunshine configuration
Config.Description: Persistent Sunshine credentials, pairing state, and configuration.

Config.Name: DRM devices
Config.Description: GPU DRM devices required by Hyprland and Sunshine rendering.

Config.Name: uinput device
Config.Description: Virtual input device used by Sunshine keyboard and mouse injection.

Config.Name: Virtual terminal 0
Config.Description: VT access required by seatd during compositor startup.

Config.Name: Virtual terminal 1
Config.Description: VT access required by seatd during compositor startup.

Config.Name: FUSE device
Config.Description: FUSE support for Flatpak and user-space filesystem integration.

Config.Name: Host cgroup
Config.Description: Host cgroup hierarchy required by systemd in the container.

Config.Name: NVIDIA GPU
Config.Description: UUID of the NVIDIA GPU assigned to Omarchy. Find it with nvidia-smi.

Config.Name: NVIDIA capabilities
Config.Description: Driver capabilities injected by NVIDIA Container Toolkit.

Config.Name: Sunshine base port
Config.Description: Keep the standard port on the dedicated container IP. Custom ports are not compatible with every Moonlight client.

Config.Name: Sunshine CSRF origins
Config.Description: Comma-separated trusted Web UI origins including scheme and port, for example https://192.168.1.250:47990.

Config.Name: Input mode
Config.Description: Headless Unraid profile: use Sunshine virtual input only; do not start the seat9 event-node helper.

Config.Name: Omarchy output
Config.Description: Name of the Hyprland headless output.

Config.Name: Resolution
Config.Description: Initial headless output resolution.

Config.Name: Refresh rate
Config.Description: Initial headless output refresh rate.

Config.Name: Display scale
Config.Description: Fallback Hyprland output scale used only when no saved value exists in the persistent Omarchy home.

Config.Name: Renderer
Config.Description: Renderer used by the headless Wayland session.

Config.Name: Allow empty libinput
Config.Description: Allows Hyprland to start before Sunshine creates virtual input devices.

Config.Name: DRM selection
Config.Description: Optional explicit DRM card, for example /dev/dri/card1. Leave blank unless Hyprland chooses the wrong GPU.
